desc: Read W,H,L,R,D,U and prepare factorials/inverses up to 2·10⁶.
Implement comb(n,k) using fac[n]·ifac[k]·ifac[n−k] mod p.
Implement the full-grid total G = C(W+H+4, H+2) - (H+3) - (W+1)(H+2) mod p.
Implement the inclusion–exclusion formula for V using the four corners of the hole and the two interaction terms.
Compute ans = (G - V) % MOD and print it.
Test with the three sample inputs to ensure correctness.
